messages:
Samir: quick follow-up from today's all-hands — when GPU supply drops below ~20% in a region, what's the intended fallback order? route to other regions, burst to dedicated, or degrade to smaller/quantized models? cc @Alex :thinking:

Alex (Infrastructure): short answer: prefer region-local fallbacks first, then nearest-region spill, then model-variant degrade. we'll publish a playbook with thresholds and SLO impact. high-level plan: 1) try intra-region soft-burst, 2) route to nearest compatible region within latency budget, 3) swap to quantized variant if capacity still constrained. will add concrete numbers. :white_check_mark:

Samir: sweet — any ETA on the playbook? some teams want to enable cross-region routing if it's safe.

Jamie (SRE): we exercised cross-region spill in the canary yesterday — observed ~60ms P95 increase for APAC->EU for small chat workloads, tail was punishing on ~1% of requests. logs show retries in the routing layer for a subset of requests. snippet from canary run:

```
2026-03-22T16:12:03Z canary: spill->eu triggered, inflight 180
2026-03-22T16:12:03Z routing: retry 1 -> region-eu-west1
2026-03-22T16:12:04Z runtime: model fallback quantized-8bit applied
```

Ops Bot: Canary deploy completed: canary-2026-03-22-59 -> success :tada:

Lauren (Product): product teams would like a console toggle to opt-in/out of cross-region spill for data residency reasons. Is that on the table? cc @Mike

Mike: yes, we can add a per-project flag in the console. rough timeline: next sprint for the toggle UI + API, plus a policy check for residency constraints.

Alex (Infrastructure): action items from here: @Jamie please run a latency/regression matrix for APAC->EU, @Mike add opt-in toggle + server-side policy, @Samir collect 2 representative prompt sets for quality eval on the quantized variant. i'll draft the playbook and post by EOD Monday with concrete thresholds (e.g., spill if regional capacity < 15%, degrade variant only if cross-region latency > 120ms or capacity < 5%).

Samir: I'll add the prompt sets today. thanks. :thumbsup:

SRE Oncall: opened infra-4321 with the canary results and test matrix, link: https://redwood.internal/infra/infra-4321 — added repro steps and per-region perf table.

Jamie (SRE): one more note — for burst-to-dedicated we should document cooldowns; yesterday burst cleared but then thrashed because autoscaler cooldowns weren't aligned. suggest adding a 90s cooldown after a failed burst attempt.

Alex (Infrastructure): good catch. will include cooldown guidance and a short checklist for app teams (config flags, expected latency delta, telemetry keys to watch).

Samir: anything leadership wants folks to hold off on until the playbook lands?

Alex (Infrastructure): hold off on enabling cross-region by default in prod. experiments and demos are fine. we'll update the default routing policy after the playbook and console toggle are live.

Mike: I'll ping here when the UI flag branch lands for review.

Ops Bot: Note: scheduled follow-up meeting added to calendar — "Infra: Region Spill Playbook" Mon 10:00 PT.

Samir: thanks all, appreciate the quick answers. :pray:
